marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots this morning then
backing to west 20 this evening. Wind veering to northwest 25 near noon
Wednesday. Snow changing to scattered flurries this morning.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures zero falling to minus 4 Wednesday
afternoon. Freezing spray beginning Wednesday afternoon. <br/>
